import numpy as np

# Data: year (1990=0, 1991=1, ..., 1998=8) and USDA outlays (in millions)

y = np.array([46011, 54119, 56436, 63143, 60812, 56667, 54338, 52558, 53949])

# Linear regression using numpy
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)

print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Predict for 1999 (year = 9)
x_1999 = 9
predicted_1999 = slope * x_1999 + intercept
print(f"Predicted 1999: {predicted_1999}")

# Round as specified
slope_rounded = round(slope, 2)
intercept_rounded = round(intercept)
predicted_rounded = round(predicted_1999)

print(f"\nFinal values:")
print(f"Slope (rounded to nearest hundredth): {slope_rounded}")
print(f"Y-intercept (rounded to nearest whole number): {intercept_rounded}")
print(f"Predicted 1999 (rounded to nearest whole number): {predicted_rounded}")
print(f"\nAnswer format: [{slope_rounded}, {intercept_rounded}, {predicted_rounded}]")
EOF
